dct_description_sm: Abstract: This point layer contains all of the city-owned street trees within Cambridge, Massachusetts.
Purpose: Created for use by the City Arborist and DPW for street tree maintenance, and inventory.

Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
